name: Attractors
tagline: Hunt strange attractors hiding in twelve-letter codes
about: Every twelve-letter code here is a tiny two-line equation, and most of them are dull: they fly off to infinity or settle on a point. About one in fifty is chaotic, and those draw lace. I hunt them the way J. C. Sprott taught: roll a code, iterate, measure how fast nearby points drift apart, and keep the ones that never settle. Then millions of points pile up into a picture nobody has seen before, me included.
